ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/off-white) across 85% of the surface area, contrasted with low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized at the distal tips, trailing edges, and a vertical median strip.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white central region; dark pigmented borders along the trailing edge (3-8 pixel width); distinct circular tan/brown pixel clusters distributed bilaterally across the interior fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an acute interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth is significant, penetrating roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with peaks and valleys ranging from 2-12 pixels in amplitude; most pronounced in the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast tan/orange clusters (approximately 10-15 distinct units) scattered across both lobes, consistent with localized surface impressions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured, dark pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) at the extreme left and right tips; numerous tan-colored circular lesions across the ventral face.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent vertical dark pigmentation line extending from the base of the median notch downward into the water line.
